reference_answers: It replaces recurrent sequence modeling with an attention-only architecture, improving parallelization and handling of long-range dependencies.
It proposes the Transformer, a model based entirely on attention instead of recurrence or convolutions.
The encoder maps an input sequence to a sequence of continuous representations.
The decoder generates the output sequence one element at a time in an autoregressive manner.
It computes dot products between queries and keys, scales by the square root of d_k, applies softmax, and uses the resulting weights to combine values.
It lets the model attend to information from multiple representation subspaces and positions in parallel.
Because the model has no recurrence or convolution, positional encoding injects order information into the token embeddings.
Sinusoidal encodings using sine and cosine functions of different frequencies.
Self-attention uses only a constant number of sequential operations, unlike recurrent layers which require linear sequential operations.
Self-attention has complexity O(n^2·d) per layer.
They used Adam with beta1=0.9, beta2=0.98, epsilon=10^-9, with warmup followed by inverse square-root decay.
The paper used residual dropout and label smoothing.
It generalized well and achieved 91.3 F1 in the WSJ-only setting and 92.7 F1 in the semi-supervised setting.
It ensures that predictions at position i depend only on known outputs at positions less than i.
It uses a ReLU between two linear transformations.
They show attention heads involved in anaphora resolution, especially for the word its.
Self-attention had already been used for reading comprehension, abstractive summarization, textual entailment, and sentence representations.
